messages:
sylvia - Partnerships: Quick sync — we need a lightweight SI co-sell / marketplace + HW-bundle handoff play for SensorCo bundles going into the cloud marketplaces. Need: 1) handoff SLA, 2) account mapping rules (who claims vs. who registers), 3) pricing/COGS alignment note for renewals.
marco - Solutions: +1. Do we want a 48h claim window on lead intake? that helps avoid dupes.
raj - SI-ops: 48h is tight for enterprise accounts. Recommend 5 business days for named accounts, 48h for inbound marketplace leads only.
claudia - Sales Ops: Agree with raj. Also propose a simple mapping table: Marketplace listing -> SKU alias -> Assigned AE/Partner. I can make a template.
harry - SI Partner: From SI side — we need an explicit deal registration token, otherwise our commercial team can't lock the lead. Can marketplace-bot auto-attach registration id on claim?
marketplace-bot: @harry we can surface registry_id in webhook payload, yes.
sylvia - Partnerships: Proposal: 1) Marketplace leads: 48h claim, auto-attach registration id; 2) Named accounts (>=50k ARR): 5 biz day claim + manual handoff; 3) Hardware-bundles: Partner gets first right to register within claim window if they contributed >30% of integration effort. Also require a delta pricing note in the quote if HW margin differs.
marco - Solutions: For account mapping, let's use this heuristic: if account domain matches partner whitelist -> partner owns claim; else AE owns. We should list exceptions.
claudia - Sales Ops: I'll draft CSV template, something like:
```
marketplace_listing,sku_alias,owner_type,owner_id,claim_window_days,deal_reg_required
sensorco-edge-v1,SEN-EDGE-V1,partner,harry,2,yes
sensorco-cloudbundle,SEN-CB-1,ae,ae_102,5,yes
```
sylvia - Partnerships: Nice. Next steps: claudia to publish template + Confluence doc; marco to define exceptions list; raj to update intake webhook to include registration id and partner whitelist; harry to confirm partner registration workflow. Please react :thumbsup: when you own an action.
claudia - Sales Ops: On it, will post draft by EOD tomorrow.
marco - Solutions: I'll compile exceptions list by Friday.
raj - SI-ops: I'll scope webhook change, target mid-week next week.
harry - SI Partner: I'll confirm registration flow with my CS lead and report back Thursday.
sylvia - Partnerships: Sweet. If anyone sees a killer edge-case (multi-region accounts, reseller chains), ping here. Thanks all :rocket:
